title: nsswitch.conf(5) — FreeBSD name-service switch

date.notes: manual revision shown in current FreeBSD branch

claims_extracted.claim: FreeBSD nsswitch.conf appeared in FreeBSD 5.0, imported from NetBSD where it first appeared in NetBSD 1.4; the implementation lineage explicitly cites ideas from ULTRIX svc.conf and Solaris nsswitch.conf.

notes: FreeBSD later added thread and NSS-module support around the imported nsdispatch framework.
